{{Quote|Boba Fett, I recognize your ship. This is Moorlu- the bounty hunter who's going to destroy you. I will display your helmet as my trophy!|Moorlu, to Boba Fett|<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref>}}
'''Moorlu''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Ailyn Vel|Boba Fett]] in an ambush during the search for [[Bornan Thul]]. However, he failed and was killed by Fett instead.
